key_insight: Color fundus photography AI is shifting from isolated image models to a co-evolved pipeline where datasets, preprocessing, and multimodal modeling are jointly optimized for stronger clinical reasoning.
clinical_relevance: This matters because integrating CFP with EHRs and longitudinal records could improve screening, cross-domain generalization, and deployment in real-world ophthalmic care.
method: Mapped CFP dataset evolution from small single-center sets to multi-center, multimodal, longitudinal resources
Reviewed preprocessing trends from classic enhancement to neural pipelines, token optimization, and EHR imputation
Compared modeling progress from CNNs to foundation models, SSMs, and multimodal expert architectures
evidence_signal: The review synthesizes published CFP resources and model paradigms rather than presenting a new dataset or direct performance benchmark.
watch_item: Multimodal and edge-oriented CFP systems may be limited by incomplete EHRs, heterogeneous data quality, and challenges in clinical deployment.
paper_title: Color Fundus Photography Analysis: Co-evolution of Data, Preprocessing, and Modeling toward Multimodal AI
